Dave Matthews Band
September 22, 2021
PNC Bank Arts Center
Holmde, NJ

Source: Tascan DR-40 internal mics
Location: FOH
Notes:  Thanks to the band & crew for allowing me to set it and forget it in the FOH area.  It's rather difficult to record at
this venue due to sound issues and crowd complaints.  For once I was able to enjoy a show!  Stay safe out there gang!
Taper:  G.Jordan - <email>
